welcome.title: Welcome to HMS-CPAP
welcome.body: This wizard will help you configure your CPAP data source. HMS-CPAP collects sleep therapy data from your ResMed device and presents it in a clear, actionable dashboard.
welcome.later: You can change these settings later from the configuration page.

db.title: Where should your data live?
db.subtitle: Everything stays on this machine either way. This only chooses what stores it.
db.builtinDesc: A single file in your data folder. Nothing to install or run.
db.ownDesc: PostgreSQL or MySQL you already run.
db.noBackends: This build was compiled without PostgreSQL and MySQL support. Use the built in option.
db.name: Database name
db.createTitle: It does not exist yet, create it for me
db.createDesc: Needs an administrator login. It is used once, for this request only, and is never saved.
db.okReuse: Connected. This database already holds {{count}} session(s); they will be reused.
db.okEmpty: Connected. Existing empty CpapDash schema found.
db.okFresh: Connected. The schema will be created on first start.

source.title: Data Source
source.subtitle: How should HMS-CPAP access your CPAP data?
source.mmDesc: Find your CpapDash bridge on this network automatically.
source.localDesc: Read data from a mounted SD card or local directory.
source.ezshareDesc: Pull directly from an ezShare WiFi SD card in your CPAP machine.
source.skipDesc: Skip data source setup and configure it manually later.
source.noneFound: No CpapDash units answered. Check that the bridge is powered on and joined to this same network, then scan again. Some routers block the discovery traffic; you can enter the address by hand with the advanced option below.
source.archiveHint: The Mule and Miner hands over the raw card files. They have to land somewhere before anything can read them, so this folder is where your night-by-night data actually lives.
source.pickDeviceFirst: Scan and choose your CpapDash unit first, or pick another option.

extras.title: Anything else?
extras.subtitle: All optional, and all changeable later from Settings. Skip straight to Finish if none of it applies.
extras.mqttDesc: Sends nightly metrics to your broker as discovered sensors.
extras.llmDesc: Uses a local Ollama by default, so nothing leaves the machine.
extras.mlDesc: Trains on your own history, on this machine. Needs about a month of nights before it says anything useful.
extras.cloudTitle: Mirror equipment and cleaning to CpapDash
extras.cloudDesc: Off by default. Your therapy data stays here either way; this only mirrors the upkeep lists so the phone app can show them.
extras.cloudAutoDesc: Otherwise it mirrors only when you press Sync.
extras.startLogin: When I log in (no admin password)
extras.startBoot: At boot, before anyone logs in (needs admin)
extras.bootHint: A boot service runs with no user session, so it is pinned to your account and your data folder explicitly. Finishing here writes the service file and shows you one command to run with administrator rights; nothing elevates itself behind your back.
extras.autostartDesc: Keeps collecting after a reboot. Starts at login, not at boot, so it runs once you sign in.
extras.saveFailed: Failed to save configuration. Please try again.

done.title: Setup Complete
done.restartNeeded: Settings saved. Restart hms_cpap for them to take effect.
done.noComeback: Saved, but the service did not come back. Start hms_cpap again and reload this page.
done.bootHint: One last step, to start it before login. Run this once in a terminal:
